translations: So glory be (to) the One who
and to Him you will be returned
puzzle.hint: This verse glorifies Allah's absolute sovereignty over all creation and reminds that everything will return to Him.
puzzle.arabic: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
